commits.summary: Qualify all twenty public change plans (verification pending)
commits.body:
On the frozen application verifier every public observer ran on both deployments. Of 43 finite questions, 42 were established and one Lucene filter-preservation hypothesis was refuted. All 85 histories and 340 cold qualified entries agreed with physical JVM trials. Warm runs reused 65 of 86 sides. All independent clean and same-path JAR replacement results agreed. The audit reproduced all 344 public receipt references and verified the 40 collector outputs from twenty passing jobs.

Add case-specific bytecode and live frame checks for CommonMark's image visitor, jsoup's cloned tag classification and Zip4j's singleton rename map. A bounded probe on each original public path applied two, two and six checked results respectively. The six original method qualifiers, six selected tests and job schema passed. Jobs 20261124-220444-consume-the-proved-jsoup-void-predicate, 20261124-220445-consume-the-zip4j-entry-selection-in-the, 20261124-220445-check-the-live-commonmark-image-visitor check full reference and substituted repetitions and withheld or stale premises.

commits.summary: Bind checked summaries and cross-project controls (verification pending)
commits.body:
Record 128 live helper applications in the same CommonMark, jsoup and Zip4j public histories, with withheld-application and stale-code refusals. Compare 48 independent and paired chart-axis transitions, three locale profiles, untouched-sheet cache reuse, eight real Kryo streams and six one-parent Lucene readbacks. An excluded child with a real sort value still produced a null parent key on the fix. The first campaign report covers all twenty original decisions, the receipt audit verified 43 collector outputs and 344 references, and all 63 local links resolved.

Bind the disclosed release graphs for SQLite and Calcite and the complete parsed Maven operands. A capped Maven probe observed 55 bound events in the repaired range history. Generated Calcite code on the parent added only to its ordered field; the fix populated both. All six affected tests, independent JVM controls and schema validation passed. Jobs 20261124-221934-bind-the-two-release-pairs-to-the-actual and 20261124-221934-use-checked-maven-comparison-returns-in qualify the release pairs, generated accumulators and Maven public consumers.
